calc
  10.choose 3 = (10 * 3).choose 3 := Nat.choose_mul_right (by norm_num : 3 ≠ 0)
  ... = 10 * (10 * 3 - 1).choose 2 := rfl
  ... = 10 * (29).choose 2 := rfl
  ... = 10 * (29 * 2).choose 2 := Nat.choose_mul_right (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0)
  ... = 10 * 2 * (29 * 2 - 1).choose 1 := rfl
  ... = 10 * 2 * 57.choose 1 := rfl
  ... = 10 * 2 * 57 := Nat.choose_one_right 57
  ... = 10 * 2 * 57 := rfl
  ... = 120 := rfl
